responsibility: Portable sockets support implementation for GNAT.Sockets and related runtime packages. Using the configuration from gsocket.h, it wraps or emulates host socket operations and data access patterns: SIGPIPE suppression, selector signalling file descriptors, fd_set manipulation, h_errno and ioctl access, hostent/servent field accessors, getaddrinfo/getnameinfo fallbacks, inet_pton/inet_ntop substitutes, and platform-specific message text and timeout quirks. It is the main C portability layer for networking in the GNAT runtime.
